def test_encode_shift():
    # Round trip: encode then decode returns original
    assert decode_shift(encode_shift("hello")) == "hello"

    # Known shift-by-5 values
    assert encode_shift("abc") == "fgh"
    assert encode_shift("xyz") == "cde"   # wraps around alphabet
    assert encode_shift("hello") == "mjqqt"

    # Empty string
    assert encode_shift("") == ""

    # Single characters
    assert encode_shift("a") == "f"
    assert encode_shift("v") == "a"       # wrap: v -> a
    assert encode_shift("z") == "e"

    # Whole alphabet round trip
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    assert decode_shift(encode_shift(alphabet)) == alphabet

    print("All encode_shift tests passed.")


def test_decode_shift():
    # Known values
    assert decode_shift("fgh") == "abc"
    assert decode_shift("cde") == "xyz"   # wraps around alphabet
    assert decode_shift("mjqqt") == "hello"

    # Empty string
    assert decode_shift("") == ""

    # Single characters
    assert decode_shift("f") == "a"
    assert decode_shift("a") == "v"       # wrap: a -> v
    assert decode_shift("e") == "z"

    # Round trip on whole alphabet
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    assert encode_shift(decode_shift(alphabet)) == alphabet

    print("All decode_shift tests passed.")


test_encode_shift()
test_decode_shift()
